| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF134 | 4. **Use days, not a presumed number of months.** Let `D` be calendar days of registration subject to regularisation after statutory exclusions. `monthly_income = annual_computable_income_after_generic_deduction / D × 30`. | frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF154 | [Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2007-13409#a3-5) allows the starting reduction for first registration or no RETA registration in the preceding two years; use three years if the previous registration enjoyed it. Request it at registration. It runs from the effective registration date through the next twelve complete calendar months, with no cessation/training contribution during it. A further twelve complete months requires expected annual computable income **below** annual SMI, an application before that period starts, and the condition in each year if it spans two. The first period is not regularised; the extension is tested under art. 38 ter.6. Disability ≥33%, gender-violence and terrorism cases use 24 and 36 complete months instead. The article excludes joining relatives through the second degree and the specified religious members, but expressly includes qualifying company/cooperative members. | Current LF154, exact original unit |
| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF156 | **Equality with SMI: published TGSS assessment.** The [current TGSS system guide, “Prórroga Tarifa Plana”](https://www.seg-social.es/wps/portal/wss/internet/HerramientasWeb/9d2fd4f1-ab0f-42a6-8d10-2e74b378ee24/44b5f09d-6c25-4dcd-8210-c21700c67096?changeLanguage=es), expressly says that annual net income **equal to or above** SMI leads TGSS to reclaim contributions not paid because of the extended benefit and to treat that extension period as regularisable, recalculating the provisional base and quota as applicable. Current [RD 2064 art. 44.3.f](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1996-1579#a44) likewise sends equal-or-higher income to the ordinary base rules. Do not model equality as an automatically retained extension. This does not regularise the unconditional initial period. | Current LF156, exact original unit |

| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF268 | **Employer CC reduction during actual activity.** Group 1's reduction is **8.10 percentage points**, producing **15.50%**, with employer CC capped at **279/month or 12.68 per real-work day**. For groups 2–11, the 2026 order's official formula image expressly uses the **2021 reduction evaluated at the 2026 base**. In percentage-point units define `r21 = 7.36 × (1 + (B−K)/B ×2.52×6.15/7.36)`, where K is **986.70 monthly** or **42.90 daily**. Then `r26 = r21 + (8.10−r21)/10×5`. Calculate `B×(21.20−r26)/100`, then constrain employer CC to **179.44–279.00/month** or **8.16–12.68 per real-work day**, before summing daily amounts. Use proportional reductions for the statutory partial monthly period. The 2021 source supplies the referenced formula only; do not import its rates, old minima or 101.47 floor into 2026 ([2026 art. 14.4 and formula](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2026-7296#a1-6); [PCM/1353/2021 art. 13.4.b](https://www.boe.es/buscar/doc.php?id=BOE-A-2021-20075); [LGSS DT 18](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11724#dtdecimoctava)). | Current LF268, exact original unit |
| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF270 | **Inactivity inside a registration month.** First establish inclusion for inactivity under LGSS art. 253: ordinarily at least **30 real-work days in a continuous 365-day period** and an express application within **three calendar months** after the last qualifying day, effective the first day of the month after application. Apply its exclusion/re-entry and assimilated-day rules to the actual TGSS record. There is **no inactivity** where at least **five real-work days per week for the same employer** fulfil the applicable collective agreement. For an included worker outside that exception, if registered calendar days R exceed real-work days J times **1.3636**, inactive days are `D = R−J×1.3636`; otherwise zero. Use the group-7 monthly minimum **1,424.40/30 =47.48 daily**. The worker alone pays `D×47.48×11.50%`, plus separate **0.90% MEI** on that inactivity base. Where the worker had **at most 55 real-work days in 2025**, reduce the inactivity CC quota by **19.11%** in 2026, leaving MEI unreduced. Do not round away the 1.3636 day adjustment before calculating the assessed base ([arts. 14.2/3.b and 16](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2026-7296#a1-6); [LGSS arts. 253/255](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11724#a253); [LGSS art. 127 bis](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11724#a1-5)). | Current LF270, exact original unit |
| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF272 | For IT, pregnancy/breastfeeding risk, birth/care or shared nursing-infant care arising during activity, the employer CC treatment changes: indefinite workers use **15.50% group 1** or **2.75% groups 2–11** under the general suspension rules; temporary/fixed-discontinuous workers use that route on contracted days they could not work. Unscheduled days use inactivity treatment, except the statutory birth/nursing-benefit deemed-contribution periods. The protected-activity situations also have a **2.75-point unemployment-quota reduction**, separate from CC. Contributory unemployment uses the art. 8 base and **11%** rate under art. 14.6. No additional overtime quota applies in this employee agricultural system, while assessable remuneration still follows its legal bases ([arts. 14.5–7/34.1](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2026-7296#a1-6)). | Current LF272, exact original unit |

| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF292 | Under [art. 342](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11724#a342), continuing the activity causing a qualifying partial cessation requires monthly net earnings no higher than the lower of SMI and the prior contribution base. Existing employee work in pluriactivity is compatible only if the preceding four months' average monthly remuneration plus the cessation benefit is **strictly below SMI**. Social Security's current guidance expressly excludes proportional extra payments from that SMI comparator: **1,221 monthly in 2026**. Equality fails the pluriactivity test; a low part-time wage alone does not establish entitlement. | Current LF292, exact original unit |
| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF294 | Treat a TGSS debit as an identification clue. Obtain the base report, assessment and award before calling it RETA, employer RLC, reduced fee, regularisation or pluriactividad refund. Keep principal, interest, surcharge and refund nature separate. For direct-assessment IRPF, the [AEAT contribution-booking guidance](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ayuda/manuales-videos-folletos/manuales-ayuda-presentacion/irpf-2025/7-cumplimentacion-irpf/7_4-rendimientos-actividades-economicas/7_4_2-regimen-estimacion-directa/7_4_2_3-gastos-fiscalmente-deducibles/cotizaciones-reta.html) puts a regularisation in the year settled; do not amend the original year solely for that adjustment. An extra settlement payment **increases that year's deductible contribution expense**. A refund **reduces that year's contribution expense**; if the refund exceeds contributions paid in that year, the excess becomes **additional activity income**, rather than a negative expense carried into the original year. For example, a 1,100 refund with 800 current-year contributions gives zero net contribution expense and 300 additional income. Its 2025 box numbers are not assumed to be the approved 2026 return boxes. | Current LF294, exact original unit |

| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF310 | **Dated 2026 order catch-up windows.** PJC/297/2026 was published **31 March 2026**. DT 1 gives direct-settlement differences on settlements from 1 February until the **last day of the month after TGSS notifies the update**, without surcharge. Simplified-settlement differences from 1 January are assessed when the systems/data are available and collected by the specified direct debit. Self-assessment differences from 1 January had a nominal no-surcharge endpoint of 31 May 2026. Because that was a Sunday, RD 1415/2004 art. 8(b) moves the payment endpoint to the preceding business day, ordinarily Friday 29 May 2026, subject to the applicable holiday calendar. This historical window is closed. ([RD1415/2004 art.8(b)](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2004-11836#a8)). Under DT 3, qualifying RETA/first-group sea workers who had elected the then-maximum base could elect between their existing and applicable maximum by **30 April 2026**, effective **1 January 2026**. The calendar windows have closed; do not present them as fresh elections or replace a notice-specific deadline ([order DT 1/3](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2026-7296#dt)). | Current LF310, exact original unit |

| frozen GitHub-public PR branch body 0b5e62451de50220ac6d80c7813d547d08108641 LF324 | [LGSS art. 31](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-11724#a31) makes interest exigible after fifteen days from the enforcement notice/deduction-procedure communication, and in the specified suspended-appeal case. Principal accrues from its original payment deadline; surcharge interest accrues from exigibility. The rate is the legal-money rate during each accrual period **increased by 25%**, unless the budget sets another rate. For the verified2026interval,the legal rate is **3.25%**,so art31.3gives **4.0625% annually** (`3.25%×1.25`). AEAT explicitly confirms those2026rates under the continued budget provisions;this does not import a foral tax-interest rule into Social Security ([currentAEAT2026confirmation](https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ayuda/manuales-videos-folletos/manuales-practicos/irpf-2025/guia-principales-novedades/otras-cuestiones-interes.html)). Calculate each applicable rate interval separately;10000of unchanged principal accruing for a full365-day2026year gives406.25,and73eligible days on that365-day basis gives81.25. Those controls assume the statutory interest trigger and stated accrual days;they do not impose interest during an excluded regularisation window. Keep principal and surcharge accrual dates separate,and use the corresponding official rate for another year or an enacted in-year rate change. A25%relative increase is not25percentagepoints. A RETA regularisation paid within its special notice deadline has no such surcharge/interest. | Current LF324, exact original unit |
